_comment: Duplicated verbatim in org.eclipse.fennec.mcp.emf.runtime.config and org.eclipse.fennec.mcp.inference.config so each runtime is self-contained. EMFModelGuard, EMFPackageRegistry and MCPAnnotationVisibility are SINGLETON PIDs: if both bundles are ever deployed in one framework the Configurator applies one of them wholesale and discards the other - it does not merge. Keep the two copies identical, or the effective allow-list depends on which bundle wins.

MCPAnnotationVisibility._comment: Deny-list, not an allow-list: annotation sources are open-ended and contributed by whatever is deployed, and the discovery tools exist to find conventions nobody wrote down. Empty denies nothing. 'aspect.type.denylist' is a SEPARATE decision because an aspect is the parsed form of annotations and carries no source - denying a source does not hide the aspect built from it, so describe_aspects would hand back what the source list withholds. Keep the two consistent.
